Event-Based Contracts Expansion to 24-7 Trading
Updated Apr 23

    Event-Based Contracts Expansion to 24-7 Trading

    Starting at 4 p.m. Central Time on Friday, May 29, 2026, CME Group will expand event contracts to 24/7 trading, including event contracts on Bitcoin. The technology and timeline align with the upcoming Cryptocurrency Futures and Options Migration to 24-7 Trading.

    Event contracts will trade continuously on CME Globex with at least a two-hour weekly maintenance period occurring on weekends. All holiday or weekend trading from Friday evening through Sunday evening will have a trade date of the following business day, with clearing, settlement and regulatory reporting processed the following business day.

    This topic outlines information for processing event contracts for 24/7 trading.

    Key Events and Dates

    The following table outlines key project milestones and availability dates, including Market Data Platform 3.0 (MDP 3.0) channel 329 expansion to support 24/7 trading.

    Date

    Milestone

    Thursday, April 2, 2026

    New Release Launch includes support for:

    • Globex iLink, Drop Copy and Market Data.

    • STP

    • Streamlined Block Trades channel 235

    • Reference Data API

    • Streamlined CME CF-Rates and Indexes channel 214

    Sunday, April 26, 2026

    • Production Access to new 24/7 CME Globex Convenience Gateway (CGW) sessions

    • MDP 3.0 Market Data Recovery IP and port update

    Friday, May 29, 2026, starting at 4:00 p.m. CT

    Production Launch

    • CGW clients requiring weekend trading capabilities must migrate to the new 24/7 sessions.

    • Clients that want to trade during the weekend must migrate to the order entry service gateway (OESGW).

    Testing and Certification

    Certification is not required for customer systems already certified to CME MDP 3.0 Market Data, iLink Order Entry, and Drop Copy 4.0 Service for iLink. Testing is strongly encouraged.

    • New release testing is available from Sunday, 5:00 p.m. Central Time (CT) to Friday, 4:00 p.m. CT.

    • Weekend testing is not available.

    Summary of Impacts

    • Migration of event contracts on Bitcoin to 24/7 trading - (includes holidays, Saturday and Sunday)

    • MDP 3.0 channel 329 will migrate to 24/7 trading

    • New Convenience Gateway (CGW) sessions are required for 24/7 trading

      • Clients who prefer to continue five day trading can use existing CGW sessions

    • The CME Globex Sunday startup will be eliminated for event contracts.

    • Sequence numbers for iLink, Drop Copy, and market data will reset to 1 during the new Saturday startup.

    24/7 Trading

    Trading impacts to 24/7 trading for channel 329 align with the Cryptocurrency Futures and Options Migration to 24-7 Trading - 24/7 Trading. Clients are encouraged to review the comprehensive technical information for the cryptocurrency migration to 24/7 trading.

    24/7 Client System Impacts

    The client system impacts to 24/7 trading for channel 329 align with the Cryptocurrency Futures and Options Migration to 24-7 Trading - 24/7 Client System Impacts.

    Event Contract on Bitcoin contracts do not support Good Till orders.
